title_en: Notice on Issuing the Guiding Opinions on Strictly and Impartially Enforcing Laws and Judicially Serving and Ensuring the High-Quality Development of the Capital Market
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court of the People's Republic of China
China Securities Regulatory Commission

Notice on Issuing the "Guiding Opinions on Strictly and Fairly Enforcing Laws and Administering Justice to Serve and Safeguard the High-Quality Development of the Capital Market"

Fa Fa [2025] No. 9

Higher People's Courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the Higher People's Court of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region; all dispatched offices of the China Securities Regulatory Commission, all exchanges, all subordinate units, and all associations:

The Supreme People's Court and the China Securities Regulatory Commission, taking into account the actual work of court trial and enforcement as well as capital market regulatory and law enforcement, have drafted the "Guiding Opinions on Strictly and Fairly Enforcing Laws and Administering Justice to Serve and Safeguard the High-Quality Development of the Capital Market," which are hereby issued to you.

Please implement them in light of actual circumstances, strengthen coordination between the judiciary and the administration, and jointly serve and safeguard the high-quality development of the capital market.

May 15, 2025

Guiding Opinions on Strictly and Fairly Enforcing Laws and Administering Justice to Serve and Safeguard the High-Quality Development of the Capital Market

The high-quality development of the capital market is of great significance for optimizing investment and financing structures and resource allocation, promoting technological innovation and the development of new quality productive forces, and serving the construction of a financial powerhouse and Chinese-style modernization. To fully leverage the functional role of the People's Courts, strengthen coordination between the judiciary and the administration, and serve and safeguard the high-quality development of the capital market, the following opinions are put forward based on the actual work of court trial and enforcement as well as capital market regulatory and law enforcement.

I. Overall Requirements

1. Guiding Ideology. Guided by Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, comprehensively implement the decisions and deployments of the 20th National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the Third Plenary Session of the 20th Central Committee, the Central Financial Work Conference, and the Central Economic Work Conference regarding finance and capital market construction; deeply study and implement Xi Jinping Thought on the Rule of Law and Xi Jinping's Economic Thought; strengthen systematic thinking and bottom-line thinking; highlight goal orientation and problem orientation; continuously improve the judicial policies and adjudication rules related to the capital market, innovate the coordination mechanism between the judiciary and the administration, enhance the quality and efficiency of judicial trial, enforcement, supervision, and law enforcement, and strengthen judicial protection, so as to provide strong support for building a modern capital market with Chinese characteristics, assist in better leveraging the functions of the capital market, and serve the overall prospect of Chinese-style modernization.

2. Objectives and Tasks. Better leverage the synergistic effect of judicial adjudication and securities and futures supervision; improve the system of judicial adjudication rules for the capital market; refine the judicial protection mechanism; enhance the capacity and level of trial supervision; comprehensively improve the quality and efficiency of trial supervision; and provide more powerful services and guarantees for the reform and development of the capital market.

-- Focus on protecting investors' rights and interests, and optimize the market ecology. Further strengthen the awareness of investor protection; legally protect investors' basic rights such as the right to know, the right to participate in corporate governance, the right to obtain reasonable returns, and the right to participate fairly in market transactions; improve the quality of listed companies; better leverage the role of investor protection institutions; normalize the conduct of representative actions for securities disputes; implement the principle of priority of civil compensation liability; legally crack down on fraudulent issuance and false financial information disclosure; effectively increase the cost of illegal and criminal activities; facilitate investors in legally safeguarding their legitimate rights and interests; reduce the cost of investor rights protection; and ensure that investors' damaged rights and interests are quickly remedied.

-- Focus on building a multi-level capital market to assist in the high-quality development of the capital market. Legally regulate the organization and behavior of securities, futures, and fund operating institutions; regulate and restrain regulatory arbitrage; promote a return to fundamentals and stable operations; improve the judicial rules for the multi-level capital market; support industry self-regulatory organizations in performing their duties according to law; ensure a high-level institutional opening-up of the capital market; purify the capital market ecology; and prevent and resolve capital market risks.

-- Focus on improving judicial rules to continuously enhance the level of legalization of the capital market. China has already formed a relatively complete system of laws and regulations for the capital market. However, it should also be noted that the market situation is constantly changing, market practices are constantly enriching, and some laws and regulations are still relatively principled and difficult to fully meet the needs of current trial practice. It is necessary to further leverage the functional role of high-quality trial and enforcement work in assisting the high-quality development of the capital market. When interpreting the principled provisions of laws and administrative regulations, the People's Courts may refer to and apply the relevant provisions of securities and futures regulations, normative documents, and self-regulatory rules. Where professional knowledge from other disciplines such as economics, finance, accounting, or auditing is needed in adjudication, opinions from professionals shall be heard. Where there are practical differences in the understanding and application of existing judicial interpretations, further clarification shall be provided through the case repository, Fada Net, and guiding cases. For areas where only principled legal provisions exist, such as civil liability for insider trading and market manipulation, and where judicial interpretations are indeed necessary, judicial interpretations shall be formulated promptly. Relying on the "3+N" mechanism, promptly research and publish a symposium summary on jointly promoting the prevention and substantive resolution of administrative disputes in the securities and futures field. Research and formulate judicial interpretations on the crime of breach of trust harming the interests of listed companies and guiding opinions on private fund crimes, and severely punish breach-of-trust crimes by controlling shareholders, actual controllers, directors, supervisors, and senior management of listed companies, as well as criminal acts such as embezzlement or misappropriation of fund property by private fund managers and illegal profit-making for relatives and friends. Promote the organic connection of criminal prosecution, civil accountability, and administrative punishment, and effectively deter illegal and criminal acts in the capital market with a "zero tolerance" attitude.

-- Focus on improving the judicial-supervisory coordination mechanism to continuously enhance institutional effectiveness. Further improve the judicial protection mechanism; promote and improve the diversified dispute resolution mechanism; facilitate the resolution of securities disputes through non-litigation methods; and promote the deepening and solidification of "grasping the front end and treating diseases before they occur." Strengthen the consultation and information sharing work mechanism; legally support, supervise, and guarantee administrative regulatory actions; improve the efficiency of administrative law enforcement; enhance the quality and efficiency of judicial and enforcement actions; strengthen team building; and provide more powerful judicial services and guarantees for the reform and development of the capital market.

After a period of effort, the judicial protection system for the capital market with Chinese characteristics, adapting to the general laws of the capital market and meeting the needs of national development goals, will be further matured; the financial trial system, management system, and trial mechanism will be more complete; a loyal, clean, and responsible financial trial team and regulatory enforcement team will grow robustly; the role of high-quality trial and enforcement work in assisting the high-quality development of the capital market will be further highlighted; and the judicial and regulatory capacity to serve the overall work of the Party and the state will be further enhanced.

II. Further Enhance the Awareness of Investor Protection and Continuously Optimize a Sound Market Ecology Where Investors are "Willing to Come, Stay, and Develop Well"

3. Comprehensively Protect the Legitimate Rights and Interests of All Investors in a Thorough Manner. Investors are the foundation of the capital market. Legally protecting the legitimate rights and interests of investors, especially small and medium-sized investors, is a direct manifestation of the judiciary and regulators practicing politics, rule of law, and serving the people. Strictly implement the suitability management responsibilities of securities, futures, and fund operating institutions and sales institutions. When relevant institutions introduce or sell financial products or provide services to investors, they must comprehensively understand the investor's situation at the market access end, fully disclose risks, and sell (or provide) appropriate products (or services) to suitable investors. If losses are caused to investors due to failure to fulfill suitability management obligations, they shall bear compensation liability according to law. Legally protect the legitimate rights and interests of patient capital and long-term capital to participate in corporate governance and obtain returns; continuously improve the judicial environment for investing early, small, long-term, and in hard technology; promote venture capital to gather towards new quality productive forces; and achieve a virtuous cycle of preservation and appreciation of investment funds, stable and healthy operation of the capital market, and high-quality development of the real economy.

When hearing cases, the People's Courts shall not only legally protect investors' rights to know, participate in major decision-making, and choose managers and other rights to participate in corporate governance, but also legally protect investors' rights to property income such as receiving dividends from companies and sharing the capital appreciation brought about by corporate growth, and also legally protect investors' rights to participate fairly in market transactions on the basis of obtaining true, accurate, and complete publicly disclosed information and real price signals.

4. Promote the Improvement of Listed Company Quality through Case Adjudication. Listed companies are the foundation of the market. Improving the quality of listed companies is key to the high-quality development of the capital market. Legally crack down on illegal concealed capital investment and illegal "wealth creation" behaviors. The information disclosure and statements of issuers regarding shareholders and actual controllers shall be true, accurate, and complete. For illegal agreements on nominee shareholding and benefit transfer, the People's Courts shall legally determine them to be invalid and allocate responsibilities based on the degree of fault of both parties, while transferring the clues of illegal activities to relevant departments for handling. Legally support shareholders in actively exercising their shareholder rights; accurately determine the reasonable boundaries for the board of directors to review shareholders' interim proposals; and promote standardized corporate governance. Legally support mergers and acquisitions of listed companies. If the content of anti-takeover clauses in the articles of association of listed companies violates laws or administrative regulations, the People's Courts shall legally determine them to be invalid. When a listed company is delisted, investors who have suffered losses due to illegal acts such as false statements may file civil compensation lawsuits according to law. Legally and prudently hear cases of bankruptcy reorganization of listed companies; effectively improve the company's operating capacity through adjustments in equity structure, business operations, and governance models; optimize main business and asset structure; effectively resolve the debt and operational crisis of the listed company; and achieve sustainable development of the company.

5. Legally Combat Fraudulent Issuance and Persistent False Information Disclosure. High-quality information disclosure is an important foundation for the registration-based system. To allow investors to invest with confidence and promote capital formation, it is necessary to strictly crack down on illegal and criminal activities of financial fraud such as fraudulent issuance and illegal information disclosure. Regulators shall further strengthen daily supervision, inspection, and punishment for fraudulent issuance and persistent false information disclosure; strictly and promptly investigate and punish various types of fraud; strengthen collaboration with judicial organs in information sharing and case handling; and promote the strengthening of administrative, civil, and criminal three-dimensional accountability. Adhere to the principle of equally emphasizing "pursuing the chief culprit" and "cracking down on accomplices"; legally and strictly pursue the legal liability of issuers and their controlling shareholders, actual controllers, relevant intermediaries, and third parties such as suppliers who instigate or assist in false financial information disclosure; and accurately pursue the liability of "chief culprits" such as controlling shareholders and actual controllers who actually execute company affairs or use their controlling positions to organize and instruct illegal activities. Legally increase the illegal cost for fraudsters. If an issuer who should bear responsibility is pursued for civil liability, and then seeks recourse from responsible controlling shareholders, actual controllers, directors, supervisors, senior management, and other responsible entities, the People's Courts shall legally support such claims. Legally and severely punish the planners, organizers, and implementers of false financial information disclosure; legally pursue the criminal liability of third parties who cooperate with financial fraud; and form an all-round crackdown on false financial information disclosure.

6. Improve the System of Civil Compensation Liability for False Statements. Accurately understand and apply the constitutive elements of civil liability, such as transaction causation, materiality, intentional and gross negligence, and loss causation. When the People's Courts review transaction causation, they shall focus on whether the false statement is the direct and proximate cause of the investment decision, and judge whether the defendant's evidence on the lack of transaction causation is sufficient based on the standard of a rational investor. Based on the industry's practice standards and business rules as the basic reference, further strengthen the responsibility of intermediaries. Further unify the basic rules for determining the "three dates and one price" and the selection of calculation indicators for systematic risk and non-systematic risk, and improve the scientific and reasonable nature of loss calculation. If the parties dispute the calculation method regarding market risk factors, measurement of losses caused by other factors, or accounting treatment methods, they may, in accordance with Article 82 of the Civil Procedure Law, apply for a person with specialized knowledge to appear in court to provide opinions.

7. Facilitate Investors in Legally Safeguarding Their Own Legitimate Rights and Interests. Vigorously carry out the informatization construction of securities trials; actively apply platforms such as the People's Court Online Service to provide investors with online case filing, evidence submission, mediation, and trial services for rights protection; and facilitate investors' litigation and rights protection. Explore and promote the application of the People's Court Comprehensive Platform for Investor Judicial Protection, facilitating investors to understand the litigation process and exercise relevant litigation rights in a timely manner. Guide the use of tabulated, element-based model civil complaints and defense statements to improve the quality and efficiency of dispute resolution. Research and formulate work guidance for model judgments, and improve the standardization level of the "model judgment + parallel case handling" mechanism. Legally support relevant market institutions and individuals in using tools such as advance compensation and administrative law enforcement parties' commitments to compensate investors promptly. Optimize the operation mechanism of representative actions, facilitating investors to resolve securities disputes and conflicts through intensive methods. Smooth the channels for advance compensation entities to seek recourse from other responsible parties through litigation procedures, and enhance the willingness of relevant entities to make advance compensation.

8. Leverage the Role of Investor Protection Institutions. When investor protection institutions initiate derivative actions, ordinary representative actions, or other litigation cases and apply for a deferment of case acceptance fees, the People's Courts shall grant such applications if they meet the conditions stipulated by law upon review. Support investor protection institutions in legally performing their duties as representatives in relevant ordinary representative actions. When investor protection institutions, upon accepting entrustment from small and medium-sized investors in bankruptcy liquidation or bankruptcy reorganization proceedings, represent small and medium-sized investors in declaring civil compensation claims and participating in voting, the People's Courts shall legally support such actions.

9. Normalize the Conduct of Representative Actions for Securities Disputes. Representative actions for securities disputes are of great significance for increasing the cost of illegal activities in the capital market, protecting the legitimate rights and interests of investors, and ensuring the stable and healthy development of the capital market. Strengthen communication and coordination; promote the establishment of a normalized working mechanism for special representative actions; and ensure that representative actions for securities disputes are conducted lawfully, prudently, and efficiently. For special representative action cases that meet the conditions stipulated by law and judicial interpretations, the relevant People's Courts shall promptly accept and hear them according to law. When an investor protection institution accepts the entrustment of more than 50 investors to directly initiate an ordinary representative action and acts as a representative to participate in a special representative action, the relevant People's Court may simplify the work procedures and improve litigation efficiency when accepting and hearing the case. In view of the large number of parties and heavy workload in representative actions, improve the case assessment mechanism to stimulate institutional vitality. Through consultation hotlines, trial live broadcasts, online inquiries, and other means, smooth channels for investors to express their opinions and fully protect investors' various rights.

10. Implement the Priority System for Civil Compensation Liability. In the trial and enforcement procedures of cases such as false financial information disclosure, pay attention to the coordination between administrative fines and confiscations and criminal fines, avoid double punishment, and enforce them uniformly. Strengthen coordination and information reporting between criminal and administrative case trial and enforcement procedures and civil case trial and enforcement procedures. Based on case needs, coordinate the advancement of civil, administrative, and criminal trial procedures. Effectively implement the priority system for civil compensation liability stipulated by the Civil Code, Criminal Law, Securities Law, etc., ensure that the property involved in the case is first used for civil compensation, and legally prioritize the protection of investors' rights and interests.

III. Legally Regulate the Behavior of Securities, Futures, and Fund Operating Institutions and Other Market Participants, and Comprehensively Promote the High-Quality Development of the Capital Market

11. Legally Regulate the Organization and Behavior of Securities, Futures, and Fund Operating Institutions. The stable operation of securities, futures, and fund operating institutions is related to the security and stability of the capital market. When handling shareholder rights disputes related to securities, futures, and fund operating institutions, carefully review the company's equity structure and control structure; ascertain whether there are relevant agreement arrangements between the parties to the case and the actual controller, persons acting in concert, and ultimate beneficial owner; if acts such as circular investment, false capital contribution, capital withdrawal, non-self-owned capital investment, or illegal holding or management of company equity are discovered, promptly report the relevant facts to the regulatory authorities, and if necessary, may suspend the trial until the regulatory authorities handle the matter according to law before resuming the trial. When handling related transaction disputes involving securities,期货, and fund operating institutions, if it is discovered that controlling shareholders, actual controllers, directors, supervisors, or senior management have engaged in improper related transactions such as illegally occupying funds or transferring assets, order them by law to return the property and compensate for losses. When disputes arise between customers and securities, futures, and fund operating institutions regarding whether fiduciary obligations have been fulfilled, the People's Courts shall adhere to the principles of customer interest priority and fair treatment of customers, and legally regulate the operating activities and trading behaviors of securities,期货, and fund operating institutions. For complex financial products such as funds, bonds, and asset-backed securities with multiple layers of nesting, long transaction chains, and numerous participating entities, on the basis of ascertaining the facts of the case such as fund flows, contractual arrangements, and underlying assets, accurately determine the true intentions of the parties and the nature of the legal relationship formed thereby. Based on the nature of the behavior and the intensity of regulation, legally determine the impact of regulatory evasion, benefit transfer, and the public offering of private placement products on the validity of contracts, striving to "see clearly and judge accurately."

12. Legally Regulate the Development of the Private Fund Market. Legally hear disputes between private fund managers and investors. On the basis of ascertaining the basic facts of the case, such as product promotion, contract signing, fund raising, registration and filing, investment management, information disclosure, liquidation and exit, and determination of losses, accurately determine the content of fiduciary duties and diligence obligations of trustees such as managers and custodians, and the extent of their diligence, in accordance with the Trust Law, Securities Investment Fund Law, and the Regulations on the Supervision and Administration of Private Investment Funds. Legally determine the validity of contracts and corresponding legal liabilities, and comprehensively protect the legitimate rights and interests of investors. If a private fund manager misappropriates fund property, causing the purpose of the fund raising to be unattainable or the fund property or the underlying assets invested by the fund to be no longer realizable, and investors request early dissolution of the fund for liquidation, the People's Courts shall support such requests. Comprehensively use civil, administrative, and criminal means to legally combat breaches of trust and improper conduct by managers; implement the concept of "trusting the person entrusted with the task, and being loyal to that trust"; and promote the healthy development of the private fund market.

13. Improve the Judicial Rules for the Multi-Level Capital Market. Accurately understand that the main board primarily services large-cap blue-chip enterprises; the STAR Market and ChiNext Board respectively focus on "hard technology" enterprises and enterprises engaged in "innovation, creativity, and new industry forms"; the Beijing Stock Exchange and the National Equities Exchange and Quotations (NEEQ) jointly create a main battlefield for serving innovative small and medium-sized enterprises; and regional equity markets mainly provide a service platform for private equity investment and financing for small and medium-sized enterprises within their respective provinces. Based on the actual circumstances such as the inherent investment risks of listed (or listed on NEEQ) companies on different markets and the maturity of investors, adhere to taking facts as the basis and the law as the criterion, ensuring that judicial decisions are both fair and equitable, conform to market realities, are conducive to industry development, adapt to the development needs of different types and life cycles of enterprises, better serve technological innovation and the development of new quality productive forces, and effectively guarantee the high-quality development of the multi-level capital market. Based on the functions of the futures and derivatives market for price discovery, risk management, and resource allocation, accurately define the subject status and rights and obligations of relevant market participants; respect the performance guarantee arrangements of various forms of margin; and ensure the safety of trading and settlement.

14. Legally Support Industry Self-Regulatory Organizations in Performing Their Duties. Legally define the types of litigation cases involving self-regulatory organizations such as securities and futures exchanges, securities and futures registration and settlement institutions, and securities, futures, and fund industry associations. Distinguish the nature of litigation according to specific supervision and performance of duties. Further improve the uniformity of applicable law and the standardization of trial results. Legally support industry self-regulatory organizations in performing their duties. Guide investors to "exhaust internal remedies"; resolve disputes and conflicts through the non-litigation dispute resolution mechanism of self-regulatory organizations; and express demands and seek relief through procedures such as hearings and reviews.

15. Ensure high-level institutional opening up of the capital market. With fair, just, efficient, transparent, and predictable judicial work, continuously optimize the sound legal environment for overseas institutions to conduct business and invest in China, and facilitate the institutional two-way opening up of the capital market. Study and formulate judicial documents on the extraterritorial application of capital market laws, unify the adjudication standards for cross-border securities and futures dispute cases, and equally protect the legitimate rights and interests of domestic and foreign investors. Strengthen international judicial cooperation, enhance judicial assistance with other countries and regions in areas such as service of documents, evidence collection, and recognition and enforcement of judgments, and reduce the cost of rights protection for domestic and foreign investors.

16. Guide and purify the capital market ecosystem. Lawfully combat illegal acts that interfere with the normal operation of the market and disrupt the capital market order, such as fabricating and disseminating false information, "rights protection black industries", and unfair competition in the issuance and listing stage, to form a clean and upright market ecosystem. For acts that disrupt market order and harm the rights of others by fabricating and disseminating false information such as "short articles", if the victim files a civil lawsuit requesting damages, the people's court shall support it in accordance with law; if a crime is constituted, criminal liability shall be pursued in accordance with law. For acts such as malicious agency rights protection against issuance applicants, listed companies, securities, futures, and fund operating institutions, "paid deletion of manuscripts", and malicious creation of litigation cases to block the issuance and listing review process, the people's court shall support the relevant entity in lawfully safeguarding its reputation rights and other legal rights, and support the relevant administrative authority in lawfully pursuing administrative legal liability for public security administration, anti-unfair competition, etc.; if the crime of extortion or false litigation is constituted, criminal liability shall be pursued in accordance with law. Strengthen judicial and administrative coordination and cooperation, reinforce judicial protection for capital market "whistleblowers" in terms of employment rights and fair treatment, and safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of capital market "whistleblowers".

17. Prevent and resolve capital market risks. Support the risk disposal work of securities, futures, and fund operating institutions, handle cases related to risk resolution of listed companies, risk resolution of private equity funds, bond defaults, illegal securities, futures, and fund activities, and the cleanup and rectification of local trading venues in a stable and prudent manner in accordance with law. In accordance with the Enterprise Bankruptcy Law of the PRC and other relevant legal provisions, provide judicial safeguard measures such as centralized jurisdiction and three suspensions (suspension of litigation, execution, and preservation), support local governments in performing their territorial responsibilities, and resolutely prevent and promptly dispose of mass risks. Lawfully increase the intensity of accountability for criminal acts such as financial fraud, strengthen guidance and supervision of local people's courts, strictly standardize the adjudication standards for financial fraud cases, and strictly control the conditions for applying probation. Improve trial efficiency, timely punish illegal and criminal acts, bring a number of major typical cases to conclusion, and strengthen the deterrent effect. Implement the requirement to "regulate the legal more, and even more so the illegal", lawfully and strictly crack down on illegal financial activities in the securities issuance field, and protect the safety of the people's property. In the bankruptcy liquidation and reorganization procedures of securities, futures, and fund operating institutions, strengthen communication and coordination with regulatory authorities and local governments, support the disposal measures lawfully taken by securities and futures regulatory authorities on the assets and business of operating institutions in the preliminary risk disposal, and implement measures such as write-down or elimination of equity and debt for responsible shareholders and actual controllers in accordance with law. For cross-regional mass economic crime cases in areas such as private equity funds, adhere to unified command and coordination, unified case handling requirements, and unified asset disposal, equitably compensate damaged investors, and ensure timely acceptance, efficient trial, and consistent standards.

IV. Continuously optimize and improve the collaborative working mechanism between the judiciary and regulation, enhancing the institutional effectiveness of supporting the high-quality development of the capital market

18. Improve the diversified dispute resolution mechanism. Relying on the "headquarters-to-headquarters" online mediation and litigation interface mechanism established by the Supreme People's Court and the China Securities Regulatory Commission, improve the organic, coordinated, efficient, and convenient diversified dispute resolution mechanism for securities and futures disputes. Encourage the resolution of securities disputes through non-litigation methods such as mediation, summarize local experience such as using preservation to facilitate mediation, optimize the mediation-litigation interface mechanism, increase the intensity of post-filing entrustment to professional securities industry mediation organizations for mediation, improve the "model judgment + batch mediation" mechanism, and promote the deepening and solidification of "addressing the front end and treating the disease before it arises". Strengthen communication and coordination in the disposal of bond defaults, improve the efficiency of lawful disposal and clearance of defaulted bonds, and jointly build a market-oriented, legalized, and diversified long-term mechanism for bond default risk disposal.

19. Support improving the effectiveness of administrative law enforcement. Lawfully and efficiently handle administrative litigation cases, supervise and support securities and futures regulatory authorities in lawfully performing their regulatory duties. Strengthen communication and exchange between people's courts and public security organs, people's procuratorates, and securities and futures regulatory authorities, study and clarify issues of significant impact on regulatory law enforcement, such as the standard for accepting cases involving the performance of duties by securities and futures self-regulatory organizations, the standard for determining the number of illegal acts, the calculation of illegal gains when a party controls another person's account to commit an illegal act, the standard for determining unit illegality and joint illegality, and the connection between administrative penalties and criminal justice, and timely prevent and substantively resolve administrative disputes in the securities and futures field. Securities and futures regulatory authorities may, in accordance with law, take administrative compulsory measures such as seizure and freezing, and lawfully stop and punish acts such as refusal to or obstruction of law enforcement. Where a party controls another person's account to commit an illegal act, the securities and futures regulatory authority shall, in accordance with law, recognize the gains obtained from the account through the illegal act as illegal gains. Further improve the connection between administrative and criminal procedures, and better implement the principle of "criminal referral priority" in the field of securities law enforcement.

20. Strengthen the consultation and information sharing working mechanism. Further enhance collaboration and cooperation in areas such as tip-off notification, information notification, case transfer, evidence collection, data sharing, and rule coordination, jointly improve risk prevention and early warning capabilities, achieve "early identification, early warning, early exposure, and early disposal" of budding issues, and improve the risk early correction mechanism with hard constraints. Establish a "headquarters-to-headquarters" information inquiry and sharing cooperation mechanism to achieve the sharing of information on judicial adjudication documents related to securities and futures with administrative law enforcement information. Support people's courts at all levels and securities and futures regulatory authorities and their dispatched agencies in establishing an information notification mechanism and a coordination mechanism for evidence investigation and collection, and promptly notify litigation, punishment, execution, and property clues involving various types of business entities. Support people's courts at all levels and securities and futures regulatory authorities and their dispatched agencies, on the basis of full communication, in accordance with law and procedures, to access and copy criminal and administrative case files, records, and evidence materials based on the same illegal facts, to improve trial and law enforcement efficiency. Strengthen communication and coordination with securities and futures regulatory authorities, and actively and prudently handle securities and futures litigation cases involving financial risk events, high public attention, high complexity, and strong professionalism, to lawfully maintain the stable development of the capital market. Regularly jointly release guiding cases and typical cases of the capital market, conveying the concepts of long-term investment, value investment, and rational investment through cases, and deterring illegal and criminal acts in the capital market.

21. Improve the quality and efficiency of judicial enforcement. Strictly regulate securities enforcement work, avoiding circumvention of shareholding reduction or illegal shareholding reduction. Where judicial enforcement by means of non-trading transfers such as judicial deduction and transfer is carried out on stocks that are in a lock-up period or for which shareholding reduction is prohibited, and on stocks for which the parties have made commitments to restrict shareholding reduction, the people's court shall, in the judicial auction announcement, remind the transferee to comply with the provisions of securities regulatory rules on stock transfer; after the enforcement of the relevant stocks, the transferee shall continue to comply with the lock-up or shareholding reduction provisions. In the equity auction announcements of listed companies and securities, futures, and fund operating institutions, the people's court shall remind the transferee that it must meet the shareholder conditions prescribed by regulatory rules, and shall indicate the risk that the shareholder qualification may not be approved; for malicious participation in the auction where the shareholder qualification is not obtained after the auction, the relevant deposit shall not be refunded; where the failure to obtain the shareholder qualification is due to inaccurate understanding of the statutory shareholder conditions and there is no obvious malice, the deposit may be refunded. Further improve the functions of the "headquarters-to-headquarters" online enforcement and asset investigation and control system established by the Supreme People's Court and the China Securities Regulatory Commission. Establish and improve the non-litigation enforcement working mechanism, and the people's court shall strengthen the enforcement of administrative fines and confiscations. Where, before applying to the people's court for enforcement, the securities and futures regulatory authority has sufficient reason to believe that the person subject to enforcement may evade enforcement, it may apply to the people's court for property preservation measures. Explore the implementation of "one case, one application": if the securities and futures regulatory authority applies to the people's court for judicial enforcement of its administrative act, and the people's court rules to approve the enforcement, the case for enforcement implementation shall be docketed promptly after the ruling takes effect, without the securities and futures regulatory authority needing to separately submit case filing materials. When investigating securities and futures illegal cases, securities and futures regulatory authorities shall actively and timely seize and freeze the property involved, ensure effective connection between seizure and freezing measures in judicial and administrative procedures, and prevent the parties from transferring or concealing property. In securities enforcement work, fully respect the validity of securities registration and title confirmation acts, and maintain the stable operation of the securities trading and settlement order.

V. Strengthen organizational guarantees, adopt multiple measures to enhance trial capacity and regulatory capacity

22. Strengthen the construction of financial trial and regulatory law enforcement teams. Adhere to taking the Party's political construction as the guide, ensure the correct political direction of capital market trial, enforcement, and regulatory law enforcement, and forge a loyal, clean, and responsible iron army of financial trial and regulatory law enforcement. Consistently and unremittingly focus on the construction of Party conduct and integrity and the fight against corruption, thoroughly implement the spirit of the Central Committee's eight-point regulation, punish judicial corruption with a "zero tolerance" attitude, and ensure judicial integrity with clean and honest conduct. Adhere to the combination of strict management and warm care, resolutely support judges and regulatory law enforcement personnel in handling cases according to law, and strengthen the guarantee of performance of duties. Implement measures to provide preferential treatment to police officers, relieve the burden on grassroots police officers, and motivate them to take responsibility.

23. Strengthen financial trial mechanisms and two-way exchange and training mechanisms. Continue to optimize the jurisdictional and trial mechanisms for financial cases, and enhance the professional level of financial trials. Continuously strengthen the construction of a two-way business communication and exchange platform between people's courts and securities and futures regulatory authorities. Regularly organize special research and training on financial trials and regulatory law enforcement. Enhance the understanding of the regulatory law enforcement team regarding the legal system and judicial mechanisms, deepen judges' understanding of financial innovation tools, risk control means, and market operation mechanisms, promote the continuous improvement of professional capabilities of financial trial and regulatory law enforcement personnel, continuously enhance the standardization and legalization of regulatory law enforcement, and raise the professional level and quality of financial trials.
